title: coreopsis grandiflora var. longipes
intro: Coreopsis grandiflora var. longipes, commonly known as large-flowered tickseed, is a perennial plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include the potential health benefits of reducing inflammation and relieving digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Coreopsis grandiflora var. longipes may include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities, which could be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins. However, further research is necessary to confirm the exact health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant.
